brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of free area, as specified in SOP-015, and clear any obstruction before the heat event. Because Quarrydale Grove is an ONAN unit with an oil issue and advanced age (34 years), apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting thermal exposure if the unit cannot be fully attended, in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied with its reason, value, and period per MG-021, restoring full rating only after the underlying condition is corrected and verified.
